body:
my weathered bundle entry says the experimental seed run workers brushed off chalky water. my throat tightened before county trucks reached us.

No one wanted to keep the wet copy. It dried unevenly, and the ink from the first entry stayed visible beneath the second.

The younger one wanted to throw it away. I promised we would ask in the morning, and put it where neither of us could forget.
title: weathered bundle note — the first morning
gloss: A personal field trace precedes the visible emergency response.
rival_reading: Responders could have collected the chalky water while crossing treated land; the note or objects do not prove the program began the emergency.
